author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Would Adam Savage prefer fans not gift him items at conventions, and does he have any specific etiquette tips? What are some connections that film-industry outsiders might not suspect? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members Xtafa, Ryan Peck and k.v.2049, whom we thank for their support! Did you know about any of the trivia Adam just shared?
